archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO adapted for Corporate HR

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3, H4. Apply tracking-tight for H1/H2. Avoid Inter.

body.usage: Use for dense data tables, forms, and general paragraphs.

labels.usage: Uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) for table headers, small badges, and overlines.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Neumorphism with crisp inner contrasts. Flat backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-slate-800). No heavy shadows in dark mode. Max 8px border-radius.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky headers, modals, or floating panels. bg-slate-950/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and border border-slate-800. NEVER fully transparent.
visual_enhancers.effects: Subtle noise texture overlay for the main background to prevent digital flatness.

components.tables: High density, compact rows. Use Shadcn Table. Left-align text, right-align numbers. Sticky headers. Scannable grid borders for data-heavy sections.
components.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Checkbox. Use Shadcn DatePicker (Calendar + Popover) for interview dates. Never use native <input type='date'> or <select>.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog for Candidate CRUD operations. Must use backdrop-blur on the overlay.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. High contrast on active state. Must have hover transitions (-translate-y-[1px]).
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs for switching between Master Data, Interview, Training, Blacklist, Placement. Override fixed height to h-auto. Subdued inactive tabs, bright active tab.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_stats: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4.
grids_and_layouts.main_container: Generous outer padding (p-4 md:p-8), full width or max-w-[1600px] mx-auto.
grids_and_layouts.sidebar_or_nav: Vertical sidebar or sticky top nav with crystal glass effect.
grids_and_layouts.general: Do not center align the app container. Left-align dense content and forms.

motion.interactions: Hover states must slightly lighten the background and shift text color. -translate-y-[2px] on stat cards.
motion.transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out for buttons/links. Never use 'transition-all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG AA standards. Interactive elements must have focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-slate-950).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`, `data-testid="add-candidate-button"`).

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboard layouts. Sharp and readable at small sizes.

image_urls.description: Modern dark office building with glass panel. Use this for the split-screen image in the Login page to establish a corporate, professional mood. Apply a dark overlay (bg-slate-950/40) so it doesn't distract.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard exclusively in dark mode using Tailwind CSS.
For the 'Master Data' and other filtered tabs, use a robust data table with search and filtering capabilities.
Ensure CRUD operations exist for candidate data in Master Data.
Use Shadcn UI for complex components (Dialog, Table, Select, Calendar, Tabs, DropdownMenu).
Add 'data-testid' to all form inputs, buttons, and table rows for testing.
Apply 'Manrope' for headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text. Do NOT use Inter for headings.
Translate HR terms to Indonesian exactly as requested in the problem statement (e.g., NAMA, ALAMAT, STATUS INTERVIEW, TANGGAL DAN JAM INTERVIEW).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for floating elements. NEVER apply universal transition (transition: all). Always use modern button styles. DO NOT center align the app container. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use sonner for toasts. Check accessibility contrast. NEVER use placeholder image URLs. Add `data-testid` to everything interactive.
